Izilawuli zokufakwayo komthengisi zitholwe kule divayisi.
Lapho u-MaxManager efunda futhi ebhala lezi zilungiselelo.
Ayikho inodi ye-sysfs ebhalekayo etholakele, ngakho izinguquko zithunyelwa ngomthengisi we-HAL.
Le divayisi idalula indawo yokuthinta ebhalekayo futhi ayikho i-HAL yomthengisi.
Le kernel ayivezi indawo yokuthepha kabili.
Iswishi ejikela emuva isho ukuthi i-kernel inqabe ukubhala.
Ibuza isilawuli esingenzi lutho sedivayisi ye-Android ngesimo saso samanje.
Kubikwe yi-Android, hhayi ngu-MaxManager. Vuselela ukuze ufunde kabusha.
Lawa maswishi ashintsha inqubomgomo MaxManager\'. I-Android igcina ubunikazi besifunda esingenhla.
Imiyalo yokususa iphutha ithunyelwe ngokuqondile kusilawuli esingenzi lutho. Isimo esingenhla sibonisa umphumela.
Thuthukisa umshini wesimo sokungenzi lutho ngesinyathelo esisodwa.
Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisohlwini lapha zikhululekile ekuthuthukisweni kwebhethri.
Ukufunda uhlu lwephakheji kanye nokukhululwa kwamanje.
Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana nalesi sihlungi
Ibuza umphathi wewindi ngosayizi wephaneli, ukuminyana kanye nezinga lokuvuselela.
Umphathi wewindi akazange abike usayizi womzimba. MaxManager idinga ukufinyelela kwegobolondo lezimpande ukuze ifunde futhi iguqule ukucushwa kwesibonisi.
Funda kanye kumphathi wewindi. Vuselela ukuze ufunde kabusha ngemva koshintsho.
Ukusetha ngaphambilini ngakunye kuyingxenye yokulungiswa komdabu kanye nokuminyana kwaleli phaneli.
Ubude bulandela ukubukeka kwesilinganiso sephaneli ngenkathi ukhiye uvuliwe.
I-Android idinga imvume \"Bonisa phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza\" ngaphambi kokuthi MaxManager idwebe imbondela.
Uma umthombo okhethiwe ungabuyiseli lutho, MaxManager iwela emuva komunye umthombo ngokuzenzakalelayo.
MaxManager ifunda /sys/block/zram0 kanye netafula lokushintsha i-kernel.
Le kernel ayivezi /sys/block/zram0/disksize, ngakho ukushintshwa okucindezelwe akukwazi ukufundwa noma kushintshwe kule divayisi.
Funda kusuka ku-kernel futhi uvuselelwe njalo ngemizuzwana emi-3 ngenkathi lesi sikrini sivuliwe.
Ukushintsha usayizi kushintsha idivayisi, kuyisethe kabusha, bese kushintshanisa futhi. Amakhasi acindezelwe abuyela ku-RAM ngesikhathi sokushintsha.
Ikhodekhi ibhalwa kanye nokushintsha usayizi, ngakho idivayisi iqala kabusha uma ishintsha.
Swappiness ilawula ukuthi i-kernel iwahambisa ngokulangazela kangakanani amakhasi ekushintshanisweni okucindezelwe.
Lezi zenzo zisebenza ngokushesha futhi azikwazi ukuhlehliswa.
Ukubhala ama-kernel node kudinga ukufinyelela kwezimpande kunikezwe ku-MaxManager. Amanye ama-kernels omthengisi akhiye la ma-node ngokuphelele.
Idinga ukufinyelela kwezimpande ukuze ibhale ama-kernel node.
I-kernel ihamba amakhasi acindezelwe ukuze akhulule izingcezu. CPU ukusetshenziswa kuyenyuka kancane.
ZRAM idalwe kabusha kokuthi 8192 MB ngekhodekhi yamanje. Ukushintsha kuvaliwe ngesikhathi sokushintsha.
MaxManager ifaka kuhlu izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe ezivela kumphathi wephakheji.
Sula ukusesha noma shintsha isikophu ukuze ubone ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.

Ukufundwa kuthathwa isikhathi ngasinye uvula lesi sikrini futhi kuqhathaniswa nesangaphambi kwaso. Kukalwa nge-API yesistimu ngaphandle kwanoma yiliphi ilungelo; isithombe esivela ku-dumpsys sibhalwe ngokuhlukana futhi asikaze siqhathaniswe naso.
dumpsys meminfo (idinga ilungelo; ukuncozulula akuqinisekisiwe kuzo zonke izinguqulo)
Akukho ukuqhathanisa - akukho ukufundwa kwangaphambilini kohlobo olufanayo, ngakho-ke akukho lutho olufunwayo
Alukho ushintsho olubalulekile olusuka ku-%1$s KB

Inani ngalinye liphethe umthombo walo oshiwo: okuzenzakalelayo okuthunyelwayo, inani olishintshile, noma ukulinganisa okufunwe yinoma ubani okukhiphile. Asilokothi silebule izinombolo zethu njengoba zilinganisiwe.
Akukho okusebenzisekayo okutholiwe — ibhodi lokunamathisela alinayo iphrofayela efundekayo yale nguqulo.
%1$s inani(ama) asho ukuthi awukho umthombo — aboniswa njengangaziwa, hhayi njengokumisiwe.
Amanye amanani amakwe njengakalwa ngumthumeli ngaphandle — lokho kuyisimangalo sabo, hhayi ukulinganisa kulolu cingo.
Ikhishelwe isuka ku-chipset ehlukile - inani elilinganiselwe alikho isilinganiso lapha.
Idivayisi ekhiphayo ayaziwa, ngakho ukuphatheka akukwazi ukwahlulelwa.

I-Longitudinal, hhayi ngokushesha: izindleko zokubala zokushaja zephesenti lebhethri ngalinye, eziqoshwe efasiteleni eligoqayo ngenkathi uvakashela lesi sikrini. Ayikho isevisi yangemuva, akukho ukufunda okwabiwe nanoma ubani.

Iphakeme kunokujwayelekile: %1$s mAh ngephesenti ngalinye ngaphambili, %2$s mAh ngephesenti ngalinye kuseshini yokugcina
Izinguqulo zohlelo lokusebenza nemojula zifundwa emthonjeni owodwa, ngakho-ke ukungafani kuyabonakala esikhundleni sokuqagelwa.
Amakhodi enguqulo ehlukile — uhlelo lokusebenza nemojuli efakiwe akuveli ekukhishweni okufanayo.

Isihlungi se-ART esihlanganisa zonke izenzo ezikulesi sikrini. Ama-artifact ahlanganisiwe ayalahlwa uma uhlelo lokusebenza ngokwalo lubuyekezwa, ngakho inzuzo ihlala kuphela kuze kube yisibuyekezo esilandelayo salolo hlelo lokusebenza.
Ihlanganisa izindlela ezirekhodwe kuphrofayela yohlelo lokusebenza. Okuzenzakalelayo okulinganiselwe.
Ihlanganisa zonke izindlela kusenesikhathi. Ukuqala okusheshayo, ama-artifact amakhulu, ukuhlanganisa okude.
Ihlanganisa zonke izindlela, kuhlanganise nezingavamile ukusetshenziswa. Ukuhlanganisa okude kakhulu.
Ukuhlanganiswa okungajulile. Kuyashesha ukugijima, kuhamba kancane ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
Ukuqinisekisa kuphela, ayikho ikhodi yomdabu. Ama-artifact amancane kakhulu, isikhathi sokusebenza esinensa kakhulu.

Amagama esixhumi esibonakalayo aziwayo ukuthi akhona, anencazelo engakabuyekezwa. Ibalwa ngaphandle kokufundwa okubuyekeziwe ngenhloso.
Laba yibo umbiko okufanele uthunyelwe ngabo.
Isixhumi esibonakalayo siphendule; ukuthi inombolo isho ukuthini ayisungulwa ngokubuyekezwa.
Iphasi elilodwa elinemingcele. Inqubekela-phambili ibalwa kuzixhumi ezibonakalayo, hhayi ngemizuzwana.
Izixhumi ezibonakalayo ebezingekho, noma lezo divayisi ezingakuvumeli, zifakwe kuhlu nesizathu sazo embikweni.
Isikhathi, imisebenzi, okufakiwe noma amabhayithi kuphelile. "Ayizange iphendule" kuzoba umkhawulo wethu, hhayi ukungabikho kwedivayisi, ngakho akukho okubikwa njengokushoda lapha.

Ayikho indlela yokufunda ebuyekeziwe enezintambo kulesi sakhiwo, ngakho sonke isixhumi esibonakalayo sibika okungaziwa kunokuqagela.
Buka kuqala i-artifact eqondile kuqala, bese ukhetha uhlelo lokusebenza ozoyithumela kulo. Ihlala kule divayisi uze ukhethe indawo oya kuyo.

Umbiko awukwazanga ukubhalwa kunqolobane yalolu hlelo lokusebenza.

Umbiko uphethe amagama esixhumi esibonakalayo, amayunithi, ubudala kanye nencazelo yedivayisi emaholoholo. Ayinaso isihlonzi, ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho indlela yakho yefayela, ayinahlu lwamaphakheji futhi ayinamugqa wokungena. Ukhetha indawo oya kuyo ngokulandelayo.
Iskenwa ngokuzenzakalela uma lesi sikrini sivuleka — akukho lutho olucelwayo ngaphandle kokuthepha kwakho.
Dala umbiko ohlangene wemibiko yokusekela nokuhambisana.
I-Bypass isetshenziswa i-daemon enelungelo endaweni yokushaja etholiwe. Max Manager ayifuni ukusekela kuze kube yilapho kutholwa indawo ehambisanayo.
Okuzenzakalelayo kushiya idivayisi ingakathintwa futhi ivumela i-HyperOS / i-Game Turbo ilawule uhlelo lokusebenza.

Wonke amaphesenti athathwa kukhono elikhangiswa yidivayisi, akulokothi kusuka kusilingi isistimu ivumeleke khona manje. Ngakho-ke Amageyimu (85%) kanye Nokusebenza (100%) akulokothi kuhlale ngaphansi kwedivayisi engathintwa: uma inqubomgomo yedivayisi ibamba isilingi esiphansi icela okukhangisiwe, futhi ilogu irekhoda ukuthi bekuyini, ukuthi idivayisi ingenzani nokuthi yini eceliwe. Ngaphansi kwalokho, iphesenti livala usilingi GPU kanye nayo yonke inqubomgomo CPU ongayimisanga ngesandla, ifinyezwa esinyathelweni sangempela sokuvama; futhi ukusetha kusengaphambili okupholisa (Okulinganiselayo, Amandla, Ngokwezifiso) kwehlisa isilingi kuphela, akulokothi kunyuse noyedwa.
Khulisa okwesikhashana amawashi angu-CPU uma lolu hlelo lokusebenza luvula
Sula izinqubo zangemuva ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza lungaphambili

Imvamisa ephezulu GPU ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe. Isinyathelo ngasinye umshayeli akhangisayo sisohlwini (kufika ku-%1$s); idivayisi okwamanje ivumela %2$s — ukukhetha isinyathelo esiphezulu kukhishwa leyo cap esikhundleni sokuphina iwashi. Okuzenzakalelayo kuyishiya inamandla.
Imvamisa ephezulu GPU ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe, kusukela ezinyathelweni ezikhangiswa umshayeli. Okuzenzakalelayo kuyishiya inamandla.
Phoqa ukunikezwa okusheshisiwe okungu-GPU kuzo zonke izendlalelo ze-UI

Ukusabela kunika amandla i-touch boost etholakalayo ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza lugxilile; Ukuqaphela ibhethri kukugcina kuvaliwe. Ukulandela i-ROM kuhlonipha ukulungiselelwa komhlaba wonke kanye nokutholwa komdlalo okuhambisanayo.
Khubaza noma wehlise ukudlidliza ukuze ukhulule imijikelezo engu-CPU
Vimba imisindo yesaziso namabheji ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza lusebenza
Vimbela i-WiFi ukuthi ingalali ngenkathi lolu hlelo lokusebenza lusebenza
Iphoqa okwesikhashana i-CPU ukuthi ifinyelele imvamisa yayo ephezulu amasekhondi angu-3 uma uhlelo lokusebenza luvulwa, kunciphisa kakhulu izikhathi zokulayisha.
Idlula imikhawulo yesistimu ye-thermal throttling. \'Igeyimu\' ivumela amazinga okushisa aphezulu ngaphambi kokwehlisa igeyimu, kuyilapho \'Ukonga Amandla\' kugcina ifoni ipholile.
Ilawula ukuthi i-GPU ikhuphuka kangakanani. I-\'msm-adreno-tz\' iyashintshashintsha, kuyilapho \'Ukusebenza\' kuphoqa amandla amakhulu ezithombe njalo.

Iphoqelela ukunikezwa okusheshisiwe GPU kwalolu hlelo lokusebenza\'s UI izendlalelo esikhundleni sokunikezwa kwesofthiwe. Iqala ukusebenza kusukela ekuqaliseni okubandayo okulandelayo kohlelo lokusebenza, hhayi khona manjalo kunqubo esivele iyasebenza.
Ngokuzenzakalelayo ishanela RAM okunolaka noma nini lapho lolu hlelo lokusebenza silethwa ngaphambili, iqinisekisa ukuthi inkumbulo enkulu iyatholakala.
Uma isekelwa i-kernel, inika amandla i-motherboard ngokuqondile isuka kushaja ngaphandle komzila ngebhethri, inciphisa ukushisa ngesikhathi sokudlala okunzima.
CPU izilawuli ziqinisekiselwe uhlelo lokusebenza olusebenzayo.
